title: Survival Overview
subtitle: A practical survival starter with weather, reclamation, PlayerCore, SoundCore, HoloMap, and optional recovery.
summary: A survival-first ECHO template with weather awareness, reclamation basics, safe markers, recovery notes, and practical first-night guidance.
body:
Open the survival guide, find shelter, read weather warnings, mark safe spots, and start basic reclamation.

First 30 minutes:
- Open the survival guide in Index.
- Find shelter and identify weather warnings.
- Mark a safe location on HoloMap.
- Gather emergency food, light, and recovery supplies.

First 2 hours:
- Start basic farming or reclamation near a safe base.
- Tune survival_hardcore only after the normal preset feels good.
- Add MissionCore if the pack needs structured survival goals.
